turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
on your face, neck, and chest.

For a first try, start slowly:
• Use 1 pad
• Gently swipe, avoiding the eye area
• Do not rinse
• Follow with moisturizer
• Use SPF the next morning

Since you’re new to exfoliation, begin just 1–2 times per week and see how your skin does before increasing.
